title: WPMS/2134/2020 of SAURAJ GUJRAL Vs STATE OF UTTARAKHAND

paras.text:
WPMS No. 2134 of 2020
Hon'ble Manoj K. Tiwari, J.
Mr. Yogesh Pant, Advocate for the petitioners.
Mr. T.S. Phartiyal, Additional C.S.C. for the
State of Uttarakhand.
Mr. Subhash Upadhyaya, Advocate for
respondent no. 2.
Heard learned counsel for the parties
through video conferencing.
Petitioners are running Meat Shops in
District Dehradun. Earlier, the Meat Shops were
located in rural area, which have now been
included in municipal limits of Rishikesh.
Petitioners are aggrieved by notices issued by
Municipal Corporation, Rishikesh to them on
27.09.2019, whereby they were called upon to
close their Meat Shops within fifteen days.
Learned counsel for respondent no. 2
submits that the impugned notices were issued to
the petitioners in view of the directions issued by
Division Bench of this Court vide order dated
20.09.2018 passed in WPPIL No. 152 of 2018. He
further submits that petitioners are slaughtering
animals in open, which is contrary to the
directions contained in Clause D of the final order
dated 20.09.2018. He, however, submits that if
petitioners have any grievance, they may approach
the Municipal Commissioner, Municipal
Corporation Rishikesh by making a
representation, which shall be decided, in
accordance with law.
Accordingly, the writ petition is disposed of
with liberty to petitioners to make
representation(s) to Municipal Commissioner,
Municipal Corporation Rishikesh within one week
from today. If such representation(s) is made
within stipulated period, Municipal Commissioner,
Municipal Corporation Rishikesh shall consider
the same and take appropriate decision, in
accordance with law, within a period of two weeks
from the date of receipt of representation
alongwith certified copy of this order.
